title: Official Host bootstrap and load precedence
summary: Choose one verified Official set, apply on/off policy, register trusted adapters, load activation-profile layers then local-folder layers, and finally load local Lucs.

replaceability.why: The adapter and layering machinery are the Host foundation. If this machinery could be replaced by a creator layer, automatic fallback to the original could not be guaranteed. The Lucs carried by open protocols have their own replacement classes.
replaceability.decided: Acrab, self-Luc spec v0.3, 2026-10-18; interface charter rule 6, 2026-10-22

reach.notes: Trusted Host machinery, not authority granted to a Luc. Package calls remain bounded by their resolved permissions, Host APIs and editable scope.

operations.name: bootstrap_official_lucs

app.description: Application with product_id, runtime_version and data_root.

operations.notes: No aggregate startup deadline. Intended once per start with a fresh Host; repeat on a populated Host may refuse duplicate adapters/capabilities. Errors include unavailable and layer notice codes, while other index, Resolver and Host errors can escape. A rejected layer is discarded before loading its original. Safe mode ignores config and local folder, excludes layers and keeps only entries marked safe_mode. It can still use an accepted Official channel.

invariants.text: A channel verification/runtime failure selects the bundled set as a whole; it never mixes the two sources.
Official capability names remain reserved even while switched off; local Lucs load after Official Lucs.
Layer resolution/load rejection uses the verified original; original artifacts are retained for supported in-use fallback.

The creator's activated layers on an Official Luc load only while the Luc keeps its interface (luc_interface_gate); otherwise the Official Luc loads as it shipped and a layer notice names the E_LUC_INTERFACE_* code and the layers.

break: The operation rejects invalid input, integrity, authority or binding state as described by its operation.

conformance.notes: Existing tests listed here were inspected, not run for this documentation task. The area checker validates the contract files; it does not exercise runtime behavior.

known_deviations.text: Bootstrap catches selected LucError and distribution refusals. It is not a general exception boundary for arbitrary trusted Python adapter crashes.

The older Official inventory and migration matrix are not membership or version authorities. The self-Luc inventory records removed native-tool references and outdated protocol/version/default-state claims; bootstrap uses the verified index and actual trusted bindings instead.

open_questions.text: Should recovery safe mode always use bundled bytes, or may it continue using the accepted Official channel as today's code does?

official_set.description: OfficialLucSet dataclass: host; entries_by_package; migrated_tools; unavailable; safe_mode; source; layer_notices; native_aliases; editor_only; agent_withheld; local_refused; switched_off; layered_originals; layered_hashes. The last two map loaded layered Official package ids to original LucArtifact and layered resolved_hash.
